answer.explanation: The live configuration of CompressionFunction sets OUTPUT_BUCKET to 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', which does not exist. The committed template sets it to the OutputBucket resource, and the other functions use the correct bucket (lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi). The configuration was changed at 11:04:24Z, just before the window. In the window, the function logged 384 errors, all NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET at handler.py line 37. The IAM policy allows PutObject on the real output bucket and is not the cause. The recent commit cfb9fb3 only changes the zip compression level and is not related to the failure. The IaC template is the intended state and is correct, so the IAC layer is not the cause.
